d:
Cameron Boozer made history, finishing with a triple-double of 18 points, 11 rebounds and 12 assists as the Memphis Grizzlies beat the Portland Trail Blazers, 124-103!
At 19 years and 104 days old, Boozer became the second-youngest player ever to record a triple-double. He also shot 6-for-10 from the field and made four threes.
Isaiah Stewart added 18 points on 7-for-10 shooting for Memphis, while Deni Avdija led Portland with 24 points, 9 rebounds and 7 assists.
The Grizzlies improve to 5-0 and hand the Trail Blazers their first loss of the season, dropping them to 3-1.
